ADDRESSES.use_case: Used for shipping and billing purposes

columns.CUSTOMER_ID: Foreign key referencing the customer who owns this address
columns.STATE: State or province of the address
columns.ZIP: Zip or postal code of the address

CATEGORIES.use_case: Used for organizing and filtering products

columns.NAME: Name of the category
columns.PARENT_CATEGORY_ID: Foreign key referencing the parent category (if applicable)

COUPONS.use_case: Used for applying discounts to orders

columns.DISCOUNT_AMOUNT: Fixed amount discount for the coupon
columns.MAX_USES: Maximum number of times the coupon can be used
columns.USES_COUNT: Number of times the coupon has been used

COUPON_USAGE.use_case: Used for tracking coupon usage and redemption

columns.USAGE_ID: Unique identifier for the coupon usage
columns.COUPON_ID: Foreign key referencing the coupon used
columns.ORDER_ID: Foreign key referencing the order where the coupon was used
columns.CUSTOMER_ID: Foreign key referencing the customer who used the coupon
columns.USED_DATE: Date when the coupon was used

CUSTOMERS.use_case: Used for managing customer accounts and orders

columns.ID: Unique identifier for the demo data
columns.NAME: Name of the demo data

columns.ID: Unique identifier for the demo data
columns.NAME: Name of the demo data

EMPLOYEES.use_case: Used for managing employee accounts and roles

columns.HIRE_DATE: Date when the employee was hired

INVENTORY.use_case: Used for managing product stock and availability

columns.INVENTORY_ID: Unique identifier for the inventory entry
columns.WAREHOUSE_ID: Foreign key referencing the warehouse where the product is stored
columns.QUANTITY_ON_HAND: Current quantity of the product in stock
columns.REORDER_LEVEL: Level at which the product should be reordered
columns.LAST_UPDATED: Date when the inventory level was last updated

ORDERS.use_case: Used for managing customer orders and fulfillment

columns.CUSTOMER_ID: Foreign key referencing the customer who made the order
columns.ORDER_DATE: Date when the order was made
columns.STATUS: Status of the order (e.g. pending, shipped, delivered)
columns.COUPON_ID: Foreign key referencing the coupon used (if applicable)
columns.SHIPPING_ADDRESS_ID: Foreign key referencing the shipping address
columns.BILLING_ADDRESS_ID: Foreign key referencing the billing address

ORDER_ITEMS.use_case: Used for managing order items and product quantities

columns.ORDER_ITEM_ID: Unique identifier for the order item
columns.DISCOUNT: Discount applied to the product (if applicable)

PAYMENTS.use_case: Used for managing payment processing and order fulfillment

columns.PAYMENT_DATE: Date when the payment was made
columns.PAYMENT_METHOD: Method used for the payment (e.g. credit card, PayPal)
columns.STATUS: Status of the payment (e.g. completed, pending)

PRODUCTS.use_case: Used for managing product catalog and inventory

columns.NAME: Name of the product
columns.CATEGORY_ID: Foreign key referencing the product category
columns.WEIGHT_KG: Weight of the product in kilograms
columns.CREATED_DATE: Date when the product was created

QUERY_LOGS.use_case: Used for tracking and analyzing query performance

columns.RUN_ID: Unique identifier for the query log
columns.EXECUTION_APPROVED: Whether the query was approved for execution
columns.ROW_COUNT: Number of rows returned by the query
columns.MODEL_NAME: Name of the model used for query execution
columns.LLM_LATENCY_SECONDS: Latency of the large language model (LLM) in seconds
columns.EXECUTION_LATENCY_SECONDS: Latency of the query execution in seconds
columns.CREATED_AT: Date and time when the query log was created

REVIEWS.use_case: Used for managing product reviews and ratings

columns.CUSTOMER_ID: Foreign key referencing the customer who wrote the review
columns.RATING: Rating given by the customer (e.g. 1-5 stars)
columns.REVIEW_DATE: Date when the review was written

SHIPPING.use_case: Used for managing order shipping and fulfillment

columns.SHIP_DATE: Date when the shipment was sent
columns.DELIVERY_DATE: Date when the shipment was delivered
columns.STATUS: Status of the shipment (e.g. in transit, delivered)

SHOPPING_CART.use_case: Used for managing customer shopping carts

columns.CART_ID: Unique identifier for the shopping cart
columns.QUANTITY: Quantity of the product in the cart
columns.ADDED_DATE: Date when the product was added to the cart

SUPPLIERS.use_case: Used for managing supplier relationships and product sourcing

TEXT2SQL_RUN_METADATA.use_case: Used for tracking and analyzing text-to-SQL model performance

columns.CREATED_AT: Date and time when the run was created
columns.EXECUTION_APPROVED: Whether the query was approved for execution
columns.ROW_COUNT: Number of rows returned by the query
columns.MODEL_NAME: Name of the model used for query execution
columns.LLM_LATENCY_SECONDS: Latency of the large language model (LLM) in seconds
columns.EXECUTION_LATENCY_SECONDS: Latency of the query execution in seconds

USERS.use_case: Used for managing user accounts and roles

WAREHOUSES.use_case: Used for managing warehouse locations and inventory

columns.ADDED_DATE: Date when the product was added to the wishlist
